content.text: {"page":"Widgets","components":[{"id":"6:8","name":"IP / Timer","description":"Instapage: Timer (countdown) element. Counts down to ONE fixed date and time; color, language and label position. Not evergreen or per-visitor; stays at zero after the date. Labels are not shown on mobile (workaround: a mobile-only text element). A per-visitor timer is an HTML component exception. Unstyled primitive: it carries the native widget and its limits, not a look. Fonts, colors, dividers, arrows and spacing come from the client layer.","documentationLinks":[{"uri":"https://help.instapage.com/hc/en-us/articles/215452798-Adding-a-countdown-timer-to-your-page"}]},{"id":"6:51","name":"IP / Accordion","description":"Instapage: Accordion widget. Collapsible sections with separate styles for titles and content; background, arrow and divider styling, vertical spacing. TEXT ONLY inside sections (no images, no links). Best inside a Fluid Grid block so the block height follows the open section. Unstyled primitive: it carries the native widget and its limits, not a look. Fonts, colors, dividers, arrows and spacing come from the client layer.","documentationLinks":[{"uri":"https://help.instapage.com/hc/en-us/articles/33397277077271-Accordion"}]},{"id":"6:24","name":"State=Collapsed","description":"","documentationLinks":[]},{"id":"6:37","name":"State=First open","description":"","documentationLinks":[]},{"id":"6:55","name":"IP / Carousel","description":"Instapage: Carousel. Slides hold any native elements. Settings: autoplay (ms per slide), arrows inside or outside, arrow color, pagination dots and colors, background, transition time, loop (3+ slides), desktop/mobile visibility. Placement inside Fluid Grid blocks is UNVERIFIED: confirm in the editor. Unstyled primitive: it carries the native widget and its limits, not a look. Fonts, colors, dividers, arrows and spacing come from the client layer.","documentationLinks":[{"uri":"https://help.instapage.com/hc/en-us/articles/18577482154775-Adding-a-Carousel-to-your-page"}]}],"texts":[],"annotations":[]}
